options.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied selected character concept into a neutral character-customization reference. Image 1 is the selected identity and illustration-style reference.
Preserve the same original adult 20-year-old woman, recognizable soft anime facial features, eye color, adult anatomy, body proportions and beautifully finished hand-drawn cel-shaded rendering. This is a standalone fashion/game character study.
Changes: remove ALL glasses and jewellery including necklace, bracelet, earrings and rings; remove nail polish. Give her a level upright head with no tilt, relaxed neutral closed mouth, symmetrical relaxed brows and minimal natural makeup without blush. Face looks directly forward. Arms relaxed slightly separated from torso, hands open relaxed and fingers readable, feet parallel hip-width apart, shoulders and hips level. No contrapposto. Keep her short blue-black bob, but use a clean softly layered silhouette and simple side-swept fringe, no dramatic windblown hair. Her hair and current fair skin are default appearance choices, not the character's fixed identity.
Streetwear outfit: simple opaque black fine-knit turtleneck, comfortable dark indigo straight jeans, plain lace-up black ankle boots. Keep believable knit texture, stitched seams, cloth folds and boot construction. No decorative chains, jewelry, logos, eyewear, armor or weapons.
Composition: full-body, front-facing neutral catalog pose on plain warm light-gray background, diffuse lighting and subtle ground shadow. Entire head of hair and both soles inside image with at least 5% clear margin top and bottom. Portrait aspect ratio. Preserve soft sophisticated anime illustration rather than photo or 3D rendering. No scene, no text, no watermark.
